cohort: 11,290,713 singleton live births to low-income women in Brazil, including 9,886 born to immigrant mothers
finding: Although immigrant mothers in Brazil might face barriers accessing healthcare, their newborns present better birth outcomes, potentially due to mothers' health status, but do not experience the same health advantages in their first year of life.
mod_finding: Immigrant women were less likely to have a C-section delivery compared to non-immigrant women.
